**Yes, it should be compatible.** The Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra supports **Qi wireless charging** (up to 15W), which is the charging standard this stand uses. The product is designed for "Qi-enabled phones with up to 15W charging," and your Galaxy S23 Ultra fits that specification.

**One caveat regarding the "Magnetic" feature:** This stand uses magnetic alignment (similar to MagSafe-style mounts).
